file: Yahoo Finance - Stock Market Live, Quotes, Business & Finance News.htm

page-structure.evidence: Title 'Yahoo Finance - Stock Market Live, Quotes, Business & Finance News' is descriptive (2.4.2 passes). Heading tree is missing h1/h2 — only h3s present (News, Life, Entertainment, Finance, Sports, New on Yahoo, Yahoo Finance, Trending Tickers, U.S. markets closed, Symbols, Trending Tickers). The single h1 'Yahoo Finance' appears in DOM after six h3s — it is out of sequence and the h3s have no parent h2, so the tree has no h1→h2→h3 hierarchy. Missing h1 is best-practice (axe page-has-heading-one). axe landmark-banner-is-top-level flagged: a div[role=banner] is nested inside another landmark; axe landmark-no-duplicate-banner flagged: two banner landmarks (header + div[role=banner]); axe landmark-unique flagged: multiple unlabeled header/nav/search landmarks. axe region flagged: skip-link anchors and some content are outside any landmark.

grouping-and-reading-order.evidence: 116 ul/ol elements have list-style:none with no role='list' override — these will lose list semantics in Safari+VoiceOver (WebKit strips list role when list-style:none). This is a systemic issue covering the nav menus, ticker lists, sidebar lists. tabWalk order matches visual top-to-bottom order for the visited elements. No modal background hide issue found in static DOM (dialog-963 is aria-hidden=true).

reflow.evidence: At 320x900 viewport: scrollW=1037, clientW=320 — the page overflows by ~717px. Overflowing elements include the main header (HEADER.hideOnPrint), ybar sticky nav (DIV.ybar-sticky), and general layout divs — these are not exempt content types (data tables, maps). General layout overflow requires 2D scrolling at 400% zoom equivalent.
